svg.title: Allocate Startup Cash Before Pursuit Volume
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate Startup Cash Before Pursuit Volume; subtitle: Four buckets across $25,000, $100,000, and $150,000 funding plans.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric bar values represent the selected $100,000 startup plan in USD. Each stage also specifies its $25,000 lean-plan and $150,000 upper-plan allocation. These are funding alternatives, not the Conservative, Base, or Scaled annual earnings scenarios.; caption: Lean: $10,000 + $5,000 + $6,000 + $4,000 = $25,000. Selected: $40,000 + $20,000 + $25,000 + $15,000 = $100,000. Upper: $60,000 + $30,000 + $38,000 + $22,000 = $150,000.; stages: label: Working-capital runway; value: Selected $40,000; lean $10,000; upper $60,000; numeric value: 40000.0; detail: Hold cash for staged operating commitments and collection timing. At $5,000 monthly operating expense, these allocations cover two, eight, and twelve months before receipts; at $25,000 they cover 0.4, 1.6, and 2.4 months. Direct delivery costs can require additional cash.; label: Contracting and risk setup; value: Selected $20,000; lean $5,000; upper $30,000; numeric value: 20000.0; detail: Fund scoped agreement review, insurance placement, entity administration, and jurisdiction-specific operating procedures. SAM.gov registration itself is free; any paid assistance must be separately described rather than represented as a government registration charge.; label: Bid-desk systems and launch delivery; value: Selected $25,000; lean $6,000; upper $38,000; numeric value: 25000.0; detail: Fund secure document storage, access controls, CRM setup, calendar automation, and limited launch contractor work. Use SAM.gov alerts, Microsoft 365, and documented checklists before purchasing overlapping research subscriptions.; label: Pipeline development; value: Selected $15,000; lean $4,000; upper $22,000; numeric value: 15000.0; detail: Fund targeted supplier outreach, capability interviews, industry meetings, and scoped proposal development. Model the stated 6–18 months to first deal; startup cash alone does not support every combination of that delay and the $5,000–$25,000 monthly operating range.

rect.title: label: Working-capital runway; numeric value: 40000.0; value: Selected $40,000; lean $10,000; upper $60,000; detail: Hold cash for staged operating commitments and collection timing. At $5,000 monthly operating expense, these allocations cover two, eight, and twelve months before receipts; at $25,000 they cover 0.4, 1.6, and 2.4 months. Direct delivery costs can require additional cash.

label: Contracting and risk setup; numeric value: 20000.0; value: Selected $20,000; lean $5,000; upper $30,000; detail: Fund scoped agreement review, insurance placement, entity administration, and jurisdiction-specific operating procedures. SAM.gov registration itself is free; any paid assistance must be separately described rather than represented as a government registration charge.

rect.title: label: Bid-desk systems and launch delivery; numeric value: 25000.0; value: Selected $25,000; lean $6,000; upper $38,000; detail: Fund secure document storage, access controls, CRM setup, calendar automation, and limited launch contractor work. Use SAM.gov alerts, Microsoft 365, and documented checklists before purchasing overlapping research subscriptions.

rect.title: label: Pipeline development; numeric value: 15000.0; value: Selected $15,000; lean $4,000; upper $22,000; detail: Fund targeted supplier outreach, capability interviews, industry meetings, and scoped proposal development. Model the stated 6–18 months to first deal; startup cash alone does not support every combination of that delay and the $5,000–$25,000 monthly operating range.

text.title: Assumptions: Numeric bar values represent the selected $100,000 startup plan in USD. Each stage also specifies its $25,000 lean-plan and $150,000 upper-plan allocation. These are funding alternatives, not the Conservative, Base, or Scaled annual earnings scenarios.
